archetypes.name: dyn-runlog-gate
archetypes.rationale: Run-log completeness gating is reachability-sensitive and must avoid false passes or false blocks.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new required-artifact gate in the run-log commit path. Focus on whether reachability predicates match existing verify-completeness behavior and whether missing required artifacts are refused only at the intended commit seam. Check empty run-dir, placeholder run-id, scrub-failure, and volatile-only paths for preserved behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
